subject: Eval contribution & sandboxing timeline and constraints
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@brightcart.com>, BrightCart Ops <ops@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval contribution & sandboxing timeline and constraints

Hi Sara / BrightCart team,

Thanks again for the productive call today. We put together the attached one-page MAP and a sample prompt pack so we can get the exchange moving. High-level proposal below — wrote it as milestones so it can slot into the mutual action plan: 

- Phase A (Preview ingest): BrightCart supplies a 5k-sample dataset + prompt pack (ZIP) by 2025-09-02. Redwood will load into a read-only sandbox for evaluation and run the agreed test harness.
- Phase B (Sandbox acceptance): After benchmark runs (7 business days), BrightCart will receive a test report and if acceptance gates pass we bump to an expanded sandbox (30k samples) for 14 days.
- Data handling & constraints: ingest-only license, non-production use, no redistribution, no derivative dataset distribution. Ephemeral access tokens only; keys rotated weekly. BrightCart confirms PI/PII redaction prior to transfer.
- Retention & destruction: Redwood retains the sample data in the sandbox for a maximum of 30 days post-sandbox close, then performs verifiable deletion and provides signed confirmation.
- Acceptance gates: defined QA suite pass rate >= 92% on the test set; token budget and throughput SLOs to be negotiated in the MAP draft.

Please review the attached MAP PDF and sample prompt pack. If this aligns, can you confirm by EOD Tuesday (2025-08-26) so Karthik and I can publish the MAP draft and we’ll schedule a kickoff for Wednesday morning PT. If you have legal or security redlines (DPA/NDA additions, data lineage proof), flag them and we’ll loop in security.

Attachments: BrightCart_Eval_MAP_20250825.pdf (MAP one-pager), sample_promptpack_v1.zip (prompt examples + metadata CSV)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0132

--
Note: This plan is intended to enable an evaluation — any production usage requires a separate contract and encryption-in-transit/at-rest controls agreed in writing.

From: Sara Li <sara.li@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: BrightCart Ops <ops@brightcart.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 14:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Eval contribution & sandboxing timeline and constraints

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear milestones. A couple quick clarifications before we sign off: 

1) License: when you say "ingest-only license," we want to confirm BrightCart retains ownership of the contributed data and grants Redwood a limited license to run evaluation workloads only. No model training without explicit consent.
2) Key rotation and access: can you confirm who in our org will be on the allowlist and whether SSO (SAML) can be enforced for the sandbox UI?
3) Deletion proof: what format is the signed deletion confirmation? A simple signed statement is fine; we want a little more detail on retention exceptions (e.g., logs).

We also have a DPA question — our legal team may request a short addendum around data locality (EU customers scope). I'll loop legal if needed.

If you can update the MAP draft with the ownership/license language and the deletion confirmation template, we can move fast. We are good for a kickoff Wed morning PT, Sara and our Ops lead can attend.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Head of Data Partnerships, BrightCart Inc.
sara.li@brightcart.com
+1 (212) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Sara Li <sara.li@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval contribution & sandboxing timeline and constraints

Marissa / Sara —

Thanks, Sara — good points. I drafted a MAP doc (attached) that embeds the license language and an explicit deletion confirmation template. Key calls out: 

- Ownership: BrightCart retains IP and dataset ownership. Redwood is granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-sublicensable license to process the data solely for evaluation work described in the MAP; no training or derivative dataset creation without separate written consent.
- Deletion confirmation template: short form (attached) plus a log digest (hashes + deletion timestamps) we commit to produce to the BrightCart security contact.
- Access controls: sandbox UI enforces SSO where available; we will provision service accounts for automated runs and rotate secrets weekly.
- Acceptance & metrics: QA suite (see section 3) with pass thresholds, plus a throughput / token budget (we propose 500k tokens total in Phase B).

I've attached MAP-draft-BC-v1.docx. Suggest we treat this as the working draft: if legal wants a DPA addendum we can append it as an exhibit. If BrightCart confirms ownership/licensing language and SSO requirement, I’ll incorporate and publish a final MAP by EOD Tue (2025-08-26).

Next steps (proposed):
- Tue 2025-08-26: Confirm license language + allowlist for sandbox users
- Wed 2025-08-27 09:30 PT: Kickoff + runbook review (30 minutes)
- Wed 2025-09-03: Phase A deliverable ingested and initial test report within 5 business days

Att: MAP-draft-BC-v1.docx

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference

Sara — thanks for the questions. We incorporated the ownership paragraph and the deletion template into the MAP draft (see Karthik's attachment). Summary of updates and confirmed next steps: 

- License & ownership: BrightCart retains ownership; Redwood limited evaluation license added (no training).
- Deletion proof: we'll provide a signed deletion statement + SHA256 digest of deleted files and a timestamped S3 lifecycle event log extract.
- Access: SAML SSO for your sandbox UI; please send allowlist emails for the two Ops users and Sara.
- Timeline: Kickoff scheduled Wed 2025-08-27 at 09:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Phase A delivery target: 2025-09-03.

Next action items for BrightCart: confirm the two Ops allowlist emails and sign the MAP PDF (I can push to DocuSign when you confirm). Ben / Neha — I'll need a quick check on token budget and whether 500k tokens in Phase B is a feasible default.

Related links: HubSpot deal attached here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/39842; MAP draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC-ExampleDriveLink

Attachments: MAP-draft-BC-v1.docx (working draft)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll keep the MAP as the single source of truth for close dates and acceptance gates.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.inference
